name: Vul'Gol Ogre Mound
summary: In southern Duskwood, Vul'Gol Ogre Mound lies under the Splinter Fist ogres and their chieftain, Zzarc'Vul. Ruined farmhouses and a cavern beneath the basin hold the clan's carcasses and scavenged plunder.

sections.title: A Blighted Homestead
sections.body: Southwest of the fork toward Stranglethorn Vale, the basin is home to the Splinter Fist clan. Human families once farmed here, but they fled or perished, leaving hollow cabins that the ogres use for shelter. In the cavern beneath the rise, slaughtered black bears lie in piles. Zzarc'Vul rules the encampment, keeping odd trinkets beside ordinary goods the clan has scavenged.

sections.title: A Menace on the Southern Border
sections.body: Darkshire's Night Watch is stretched thin, guarding the town from rabid worgen and restless dead. Commander Althea Ebonlocke and her militia rely on outside mercenaries to thin the Splinter Fist ranks before the ogres push north. The clan has also raided the recluse Abercrombie, stealing a crate of his alchemical tools. Inquisitive mages seek arcane lenses that Zzarc'Vul is rumored to possess.

faq.q: Who lives in the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound?
faq.answer: The Splinter Fist clan of ogres lives at Vul'Gol, led by the chieftain Zzarc'Vul. They dwell in ruined human cottages and a cavern beneath the basin.

faq.q: Why hasn't the Night Watch cleared out the ogres?
faq.answer: The Night Watch lacks the manpower to attack the southern basin in force. Darkshire faces undead, worgen, and the horrors of Addle's Stead, so the militia hires traveling adventurers to thin the Splinter Fist ranks instead of risking its guards.

faq.q: Who lived here before the ogres?
faq.answer: Human homesteaders once farmed this peaceful pocket of southern Duskwood. When the curse fell on the land, the farms fell to ruin, and invading ogres claimed the abandoned buildings.

faq.q: Why did the hermit Abercrombie send me here?
faq.answer: The Splinter Fist ogres ambushed Abercrombie and stole a crate of his herbs and embalming tools. Unable to fight them himself, he sends travelers to the mound to recover his goods.
Vul'Gol lies in far southern Duskwood, southwest of the road junction that leads south toward the Stranglethorn Vale border.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers, keeping the Splinter Fist contained at Vul'Gol helps keep the southern route to Stranglethorn Vale open through a dangerous forest.
As a human, the smashed farmsteads in the basin remind you how much of Duskwood the kingdom of Stormwind has lost over the past generation.
